scope: Spline ecthr_el/loose acceptance only. 3D Bayesian phi_h on a copy of fits/spline/ecthr_el/loose/fit_copy.root, Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. The file has rdf, mdf, gdf, Background, and Bayesian histograms and no RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, or 5D histograms. Those families were not created. No publication. The source fit, budgets, sector exclusions, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. This copy does not replace the source. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows selected by these histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 of 452 are narrower than 0.05, and the C windows have median width 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so they can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms from the manual baseline, opening limits only where this histogram's cosine was outside the manual window or the stored curve was off that cosine. It improved the pinned bins and made 15 worse. Those 15 had no manual start, so the second pass pinned them, including (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16) at B=-0.045. Pass 2 put those 15 back on the stored cosine, kept the pass-1 improvements, and refit only Q2-y 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 13, and 14. Q2-y 2, 5, 8, 12, 15, 16, and 17 were not refit again and did not move. JSON still has 452 bins. 44 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is worse (largest increase 1.46e-05). (1,8) moved from the pinned B=-0.045000, statistical error 0.019974, C=0.003486, error 0.006648, chi-squared 44.758, NDF 13, to B=-0.125696, statistical error 0.034699, C=-0.044522, error 0.031904, chi-squared 39.277, NDF 13, status completed, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine. The nominal Bayesian value is B=-0.125184 and was not imposed.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved onto the nominal. Kept shifts: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.19847 versus nominal -0.15443; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.17210 versus nominal -0.13868. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. No comparison was filled with zero. The source was not removed from the budget, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.

(1,8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty.
